$meta.figmaFileKeyProvenance: ASSERTED, NOT MEASURED — the Figma desktop MCP serves the active tab and never reports a file key.

purpose: Page-level message bars and related-settings chips: contextual information, status updates, alerts, and setting shortcuts. This was the last Figma section with zero GitHub representation.

sharedGeometry.widthRule: 100% of content area in patterns (page messages instance measured 800×112 in pattern-page-data-table)
sharedGeometry.internalNote: row-by-row internals measured on the Information variant (81:32): title 20h at y0, description 40h (2 lines) at y28, action label 20h at y76; the 96h variants carry the same anatomy one description line shorter — their internals were not individually measured

closeButton.note: optional close exists in the master (21280:1557) but ships hidden

title.fonts: Inter Medium-weight rendering at 12px on a 20px line (bindings: font-size/caption + line-height/body-base)
title.note: style-level name not read per text node

surface.note: matches the rendered yellow; per-variant binding not read

surface.defect: F-016: the purple surface is NOT variable-bound — the variant's bindings contain no surface token at all. Needs an owner decision (candidate: a new surface/ai-subtle, or field/bg-ai).

variants.namingDefect: the variant is literally named 'Variant8' — visually identical to Setting Panel in the set render; purpose undocumented. Figma-side cleanup candidate.

variants.note: adds a trailing 'View Settings' action (text/brand) after the title

behavior: Message bars sit at the top or bottom of a page's content area (the page-info footer of pattern-page-data-table instances one at 800×112) and carry title + description + one optional action link; the hidden close affordance exists for dismissible messages. Setting chips are compact shortcuts linking to related settings.

accessibility.colour: every bar pairs its colour with an icon + title — colour is never the only signal
accessibility.roles: Alert/Error and Warning bars: role=alert / aria-live; Information/Confirmation: role=status
accessibility.actionLink: the action label is a real link/button, keyboard focusable
accessibility.contrast: text/primary + text/secondary on the subtle surfaces pass AA (dark-on-tint); the Change variant cannot be certified until its surface is token-bound (F-016)

defects: F-016: Change variant's purple surface is not variable-bound (no surface token in its bindings) — owner decision needed
Variant8 is an undocumented near-duplicate of Setting Panel — naming/dedupe cleanup with Figma-AI
Tooltip and Warning render on the same warning-subtle yellow — intended distinction is the icon only; confirm with owner
the 96h bars' internal rows were not individually measured (anatomy verified on the 112h Information variant)
notVerified: per-variant surface bindings for Tooltip/Confirmation/Warning/Alert (set-level bindings + rendered colours match the named tokens; individual reads not taken)
icon glyph names beyond privacy_tip/settings (visual identification from the set render)
